concept.title: Swimming sessions and lessons
concept.shortdesc: Organised swimming sessions, lessons, family or social swims and swimming clubs where people swim or learn to swim as an activity.

conbody.note: Draft category. The name and definition were written by a language model from a clustering of real service descriptions, and no person has reviewed them.

ul.li: simply using the swimming pool: see (open pool use rather than a named session or lesson)
kayaking and canoeing sessions: see (paddling sports, not swimming)
general sports sessions: see (mixed or unspecified sports)
